'''Meeba''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
He was born 40 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the conflict and was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Relentless (cruiser)|''Relentless'']]. He led the ship when it was assigned to [[Strike Force Cularin]] and later led a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force at the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].
